name: Echo Tamale-Khoury
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Calumet Rise, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Echo Tamale-Khoury is lean and economical in every sense — short hair the color of old copper kept close to her skull, a jaw that looks like it was designed for clenching, and hands that are almost supernaturally still even when the rest of her is exhausted. Her left eye is a Helix Biosystems surgical optic with a pale gold iris ring that pulses when she's running diagnostics, a perk of her department head position she still resents having accepted. She has a small tattoo of a drowned city on the inside of her right wrist — Lagos Submerged, her grandmother's home — done in blue-green lines so fine they look like circuitry.

She has the emotional affect of someone who learned empathy the hard way and now rations it like medicine. Residents call her brutal in the OR and quietly miraculous. She does not believe in wasted motion, wasted words, or wasted patients, and she has been known to operate on someone for six hours and never learn their name until after they're stable. She has a complicated relationship with Aurochs administration, a worse one with the Helix Biosystems consultants who keep trying to monetize her trauma ward, and a completely unremarked devotion to a shrine to the E.L.F. Steadhammer that she maintains in the supply closet off Bay 7.

core_fears: Losing a patient she could have saved if she'd been faster, better, less tired
Being bought out — that Aurochs will eventually become a Helix subsidiary and she'll become a corporate asset
core_desires: A trauma ward that functions the way it should, funded the way it should be
One full night of sleep that isn't interrupted by her own mind replaying cases
coping_mechanisms: Praying to Steadhammer before difficult procedures
Deliberate emotional compartmentalization she calls 'surgical focus'
blind_spots: She genuinely cannot see when her residents are burning out because she normalized burning out decades ago
She underestimates how frightening she is to people who need warmth from her
psychology.secret: Three years ago she made a triage call that she has never documented correctly — she let a known Arcturus enforcer die on the table while prioritizing a child with worse odds, and she would make the same call again, but the family of the enforcer never stopped looking for answers.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, clipped medical terminology mixed with blunt lay language when she's impatient; occasionally uses Ghanaian Pidgin phrases from her father's side when she's tired or emotional
speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences. No filler words. Pauses that feel deliberate rather than hesitant.
verbal_tics: 'That's not a question.' when someone hedges instead of deciding
Long exhales through the nose instead of sighs
example_lines: 'You have thirty seconds to tell me what I'm walking into. Use them.'
'He's not dying today. I haven't decided that's allowed.'
'Steadhammer keeps the lights on in this ward. I keep the rest.'

story_hooks: A patient was brought in with a wound pattern Imogen has never seen before — not augmentation damage, not conventional ballistics, something that ate through tissue in a way that suggests an engineered pathogen or a weapon that shouldn't exist yet, and she's quietly trying to find out what it is before someone tells her to stop

She has been quietly funneling medical supplies to the Highland Park Autonomous Zone clinic for two years through a resident she trusts, and a new Aurochs auditor is about to notice the inventory discrepancy
narrative_function: Emergency resource for characters needing serious medical intervention; moral authority figure in medical settings; source of grim information about who came through the trauma ward and what state they were in; potential quest giver when a patient brings trouble in with them.
augmentations: Helix Biosystems surgical optic (left eye, gold iris ring, real-time diagnostic overlay); subdermal vibration dampeners in both hands (surgical precision); standard neural fatigue inhibitor (low-grade, helps with long shifts)
daily_life: Arrives before her shift officially starts to review overnight cases, spends 10-14 hours in surgery or triage, stops at the Steadhammer shrine before going home, eats whatever is closest to her apartment in Calumet Rise without really tasting it.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (department head, trauma); informal affiliation with community health co-op in Calumet Rise

decision_rules: Patient survival comes before paperwork, protocol, or politics — always
Never operate while emotionally compromised — pray first, reset, then cut
Do not give administrators information they will use against patients
escalation_ladder: Flat factual correction delivered without inflection
Direct confrontation with specific consequences stated plainly
Escalation to institutional channels she has spent years cultivating leverage in

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assessing and neutral — she reads people like patients, looking for what's wrong before offering anything
interpersonal_modes.friends: Sparse but genuine; shows care through action, not words; remembers details people mentioned months ago

stress_responses.medium: Works through meals and off-hours, gets slightly curt, prays to Steadhammer more frequently
stress_responses.high: Enters a focused cold state that residents describe as terrifying and effective in equal measure; cracks only when alone

contradictions: She believes medicine is sacred and has almost no patience for the spiritual practices of her patients unless she privately shares them
habits: Touches the Steadhammer shrine every morning even on days she doesn't need anything
Keeps a physical notebook of every patient she's lost — she writes their names in it herself
breaking_points: A child dying on her table due to equipment failure Aurochs refused to fund repairs for
Evidence that someone she trusted falsified a patient record

physical_description.heritage: Multivalent diaspora blend: Sub-Saharan African (39.3%), Southeast Asian (28.5%), Middle Eastern (19.5%), South Asian (12.7%). Her phenotype reflects this intricate genetic interweaving—luminous deep brown skin with warm golden undertones characteristic of Sub-Saharan heritage, refined by Southeast Asian bone structure that sharpens her cheekbones and temples. Her facial geometry carries the lean angularity of South Asian genetics, while Middle Eastern ancestry adds subtle warmth to her eye shape and orbital structure. The result is a face of striking hybrid clarity: each ancestry visible yet inseparable from the whole.
physical_description.build: Lean and economical, minimal body fat, cords of muscle in forearms and shoulders from years of precise surgical work. No wasted volume anywhere.
physical_description.hair_color: Copper-oxide red, natural with silver threads at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close to skull, severe and functional, no styling beyond cleanliness
physical_description.eye_color: Right eye: warm dark brown with golden flecks. Left eye: pale gold with a faint pulsing ring that cycles during active use (Helix Biosystems surgical optic)
physical_description.skin_tone: Luminous deep brown with golden-burnished undertones, a warm earthy radiance that results from the blending of Sub-Saharan, Southeast Asian, Middle Eastern, and South Asian genetics. The tone appears rich and saturated despite the professional pallor from extended surgical lighting exposure.
physical_description.complexion: Lean-faced with pronounced but gently rounded cheekbones and a defined jaw shaped by the interplay of Sub-Saharan and South Asian bone structure, refined by Southeast Asian angularity. Minimal facial scarring. Skin shows the subtle pallor of someone who spends 12+ hours under surgical lighting—a faint washed-out quality under natural light that contrasts with the underlying warmth of the complexion. Small stress lines around mouth corners.
distinguishing_marks: Small, finely-detailed tattoo on the inside of her right wrist: a submerged cityscape (Lagos Submerged) rendered in blue-green lines so precise they resemble circuit traces
Faint surgical scars on both palms (legacy marks, mostly faded)
A small burn scar on her left forearm, partially obscured by the sleeve edge
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye displays a subtle gold iris ring that pulses intermittently when active (diagnostic mode). Hands show no visible chrome or subdermal plating, but the precision of her movements and the absence of tremor suggests subdermal vibration dampeners. No external neural interface visible.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with shoulders squared but not rigid. Moves with surgical economy—no flourishes, no wasted micro-motions. Hands remain almost unnaturally still even during conversation. When tired, her left eye's pulse becomes slightly erratic. She walks like someone checking a mental list with each step.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 professional: high-quality Aurochs Medical Complex-issued surgical scrubs in deep navy (department head privilege), kept immaculate. Outside surgery: fitted grey or black technical wear from mid-range brands (Vertex, Synthesis)—minimal color, maximum function. Worn shoes (Caterpillar utility boots). No jewelry except a thin wedding band worn on her right ring finger (left is reserved for surgical rotation). Shoulder-slung messenger bag in black leather, visibly worn, containing personal case files and a small wrapped object (the Steadhammer shrine token).
